source: Sprint 2 BE-18: `to taste` only for seasonings
note: A `to taste` line counts as 0 g. That is only honest for seasonings whose amount carries no meaningful nutrition, so only these names may be `to taste`. Any other `to taste` line drops the recipe from the planning pool (warnings.nutrition) and is rejected at save. Names are matched after src/ingestion/ingredient_normalizer.py (lowercase, descriptors such as ground/fresh/dried removed). Fresh garlic is deliberately absent: it is a vegetable (about 149 kcal/100 g), not salt, water, spice or herb; garlic powder is a spice.
